meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
India mein oily aur acne-prone skin ke liye ₹500 ke andar kai behtareen face wash available hain jo excess oil ko control karte hain aur pores ko saaf rakhte hain.

Aapke liye kuch top aur highly recommended options yeh rahe:

| Brand & Product Name | Key Active Ingredients | Estimated Price (INR) | Best For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Cleanser** | Salicylic Acid, LHA, Zinc | ₹299 (100ml) | Deep pore cleansing, excess oil & whiteheads/blackheads control |
| **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash** | Green Tea Extract, Glycolic Acid | ₹345 - ₹380 | Gentle chemical exfoliation, fresh feel & acne prevention |
| **Neutrogena Oil-Free Acne Wash** | Salicylic Acid (0.5%) | ₹450 - ₹500 | Dermatologist-tested formula for stubborn acne & oil control |
| **The Derma Co. 2% Salicylic Acid Gel Face Wash** | Salicylic Acid, Witch Hazel | ₹299 - ₹329 | Controlling active breakouts and soothing inflammation |
| **WishCare 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash** | Salicylic Acid, AHA, Green Tea | ₹399 | Clearing oily texture and balancing skin hydration |

### 💡 Kis option ko chunna chahiye?

* **Agar aapko acne (pimples) aur open pores ki zyada problem hai:** **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Cleanser** sabse best rahega kyunki yeh skin ke andar jakar extra sebum (oil) ko roakta hai.
* **Agar aapko natural ingredients pasand hain:** **Plum Green Tea Face Wash** ek solid choice hai jo skin ko bina dry kiye oil control karta hai.
* **Classic & Trusted option:** **Neutrogena Oil-Free Acne Wash** kaafi purana aur dermatologist-recommended brand hai.[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=550%20Available%20At%3A%20Amazon%2C%20Myntra%2C%20Nykaa.%20Why,*%204.%20Mamaearth%20Tea%20Tree%20Face%20Wash.)

*Note: Salicylic acid ya active ingredients wale face wash use karne ke baad skin dry ho sakti hai, isliye ek halka oil-free moisturizer aur din mein sunscreen lagana na bhulein.*
